source.notes: Raw experiment remains authoritative; checkpoints are local and registered in the source artifacts.json.

protocol.train: official train normal frames only; per-scene merge of sequence*/train/*/*.jpg
protocol.test: per-scene concat all test frames; one global AUC/EER per scene; macro mean over 7 scenes
protocol.notes: GL192; OCBE fuse_hidden=128; 12 teacher taps; learnable rank-2 Q (random orthonormal init); group-balanced top5 loss (alpha=0.5).

notes: Comparison view of V5; raw experiment: experiments/da/appearance/20261103_variant_matrix_v5_rd_s4_t12_gl192_h128_qr2_s42. Data audit: experiments/da/appearance/20261103_variant_matrix_data_audit.md.

efficiency.profiling_config: RTX 5880 Ada GPU-3ae8a423-c7fb-db6c-8c0a-f7da0c5cc8f6; FP32; AMP off; TF32 off; eval; inference_mode for timing; BS1 50/500/3; BS16 50/500/3
efficiency.flops_counter: FlopCounterMode(TorchDispatchMode)+native_mha_flop; hand module formulas; profiler common subset
efficiency.flops_common_subset_check: hand-vs-counter: 79 modules, max_rel_diff=0.000000; counter-only modules=50; profiler common categories=['conv'], max_rel_diff=0.000000; skipped=['attention', 'matmul(native_mha_decomposed)', 'native_mha']
